dataset.name: Independent organization-name registry discovery
dataset.description: Bounded source-derived names, without a preexisting QID or LEI. Name correspondence is not an accepted FEC identity or a role assertion.

acquisition.pagination: Capture only the first five records. Verify reported counts, bounds and same-query page links; preserve but never follow continuation. Query-window completeness is not exhaustive entity discovery.

partitions.name: capture
partitions.source: Exact source-qualified organization inputs, normalized-query policy and build
partitions.purpose: Independent registry candidate evidence, separate from FEC release and Wikimedia outcomes.

acquisition.retry_policy: At most twenty serial requests, one-second spacing, 30 seconds/request, five minutes/run, 2 MiB/body and 40 MiB/run. Fixed HTTPS origin, no redirects, inherited proxy, credentials or retries. Stop after first transport/status/schema failure. Preserve failed bodies and unattempted slots. Write only to a new directory; final manifest required.

physical_schema.null_policy: data must be an array; pagination counts are integers, from/to are null only for zero results. Empty queries preserve original null/blank values. Source failure never becomes an empty registry result.
physical_schema.schema_fingerprint: Compiled first-page envelope/pagination profile in internal/source/gleif/names.go; shared exact-LEI resource profile in record.go. Exact raw resource bytes and full page retained. Unknown interpreted keys block use; known opaque nested values remain uninterpreted.

identity.publisher_record_key: Checksum-valid LEI, resource id, attributes.lei and self link must agree.
identity.occurrence_locator: Capture digest, query index, body hash and /data/N; array order preserved without treating it as confidence.
identity.record_version: Body digest and Golden Copy publication timestamp; separate requests are not an atomic snapshot.
identity.duplicate_policy: Share network requests for identical normalized names while retaining all source-field occurrences. Repeated LEIs within a page fail the page gate; all original bytes remain retained. Never merge companies or donor appearances.

children.locator: Resource position plus field/array index; prior names remain prior names

time_fields.meaning: Observation and registry timestamps, not name or employment validity dates.

rules: The generic planner accepts pinned organization strings. The diagnostic adapter verifies as-filed employer fields. No donor names, addresses, occupations or amounts are sent; reviewed roles, company URLs and benchmark IDs never choose queries.

reported-organization-name-search.v1 uses case/punctuation normalization while preserving token order, accents, letter/number boundaries and legal suffixes. Raw values remain unchanged. No broad variants, country/status filter, fuzzy fallback or pagination crawl.

Registry search is candidate retrieval, not a guaranteed literal match. Compare every result to the original string using explained organization-name proposals. Retain all unrelated results and competing LEIs.

Legal, other and transliterated names retain language and source type. Previous-name correspondence is not current legal-name proof. Entity and registration status are separate; no status silently discards records.
A complete publisher query window is not complete registry/entity coverage. Zero hits do not establish company absence. An LEI is optional evidence, never a prerequisite for graph representation.
No identity, employer, ownership, role, graph or dollar approval. Independent registry discovery is not an independent binding of a FEC employer string to a specific company.

revisions.publisher_model: Mutable Golden Copy search index and records; preserve each observation separately.
revisions.effective_projection: Offline source-bound candidates only; no accepted identity, recurring refresh or replacement of prior captures.

checks.rule: Recompute query plan, verify manifest/body pins, regular confined files, exact request URLs, counts and stop behavior.
Verify page bounds/links/counts and each resource identity; retain schema failures without records.
Keep missing coverage, competing names and missing independent identity/time/role evidence explicit; all approval flags false.

scenarios: empty successful first-page response with nullable bounds

use.retention: Retain complete public bodies and safe selected headers, not cookies or operator secrets. Live probes and accepted captures remain distinct.
use.disclaimer: Registry candidates do not establish which company a FEC appearance refers to, or any employment relationship.
